claim: Getty Center and Getty Villa both have free general admission requiring a timed-entry reservation; parking is $25 per car ($15 after 3pm).
quote: Admission is free, and requires a timed-entry reservation... Parking is $25 per car or motorcycle; $15 after 3pm.

claim: The Broad offers free general admission with timed-ticket reservations recommended; some special exhibitions carry a separate charge.
quote: General Admission is Free... Reserving a timed ticket in advance is recommended... Some exhibitions and events carry a separate charge.

claim: LACMA general admission is $25 for LA County resident adults / $30 out-of-county; free for LA County residents weekdays after 3pm, the second Tuesday of each month, and youth 17 and under.
quote: Adults: $25 [LA County]... Adults: $30 [out-of-county]... All visitors on the second Tuesday of each month... LA County residents on weekdays after 3 pm with valid ID

claim: Academy Museum of Motion Pictures general admission is $25 adults, $19 seniors, $15 students, free for under 18; the Oscars Experience costs an extra $10.
quote: Tickets cost $25 for adults, $19 for seniors (62 and up), $15 for students, and are free for visitors 17 and younger... the Oscars Experience costs an additional $10

claim: La Brea Tar Pits admission is about $18 adults / $15 seniors-students / $8 children, with free entry for LA County residents weekdays 3-5pm; the museum closes July 7 for a two-year renovation.
quote: Free admission for veterans and active military, L.A. County residents (M–F, 3–5 pm)... La Brea Tar Pits will close July 7 for a two-year transformation

claim: The Huntington adult admission is $25 (Mon-Thu) to $29 (Fri-Sun); free admission is offered the first Thursday of each month with advance reservation (tickets released last Thursday at 9am, limit 5 per household per year).
quote: Free Day tickets are available the last Thursday of every month at 9 a.m. until sold out... Limit 5 tickets per household per year

claim: The annual SoCal Museums Free-for-All on Feb 22, 2026 gave free general admission at 30+ museums including the Academy Museum, LACMA, Getty Center, and The Broad.
quote: Museums' free-for-all returns Feb. 22 with free admission across Southern California

claim: Universal Studios Hollywood 1-day general admission tickets start around $101 for ages 10+, with a Costco season pass available at $179.99.
quote: discounted 1-day general admission tickets are available from $101.47 for ages 10+... Season Pass is available at Costco for $179.99

claim: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Hollywood starts at about $70, with Southern California residents saving $12 from Jan 5 to June 7, 2026.
quote: Southern California residents can save $12 on a regular Studio Tour from January 5, 2026 – June 7, 2026

claim: Disneyland in Anaheim (~25-27 miles SE of downtown LA, roughly an hour's drive) uses tiered 1-day pricing starting around $103 per day when purchased in advance.
quote: Tickets start from as little as USD103 per day when purchased in advance... 1-Day trips to 1 Park Per Day, pricing is broken into various ticket tiers

claim: The Hollywood Bowl's 2026 'Forever Summer' season offers $1 tickets in bench sections L-U (limit four per household) for select classical and non-classical concerts; general single tickets range roughly $31-$103+.
quote: expanded $1 tickets to select classical and non-classical concerts at the iconic Hollywood Bowl. Seats are located in bench sections L-U, with a limit of four (4) tickets per household

claim: Walt Disney Concert Hall (home of the LA Phil) 2026/27 subscription packages go on sale March 17, 2026, starting at $34/month for curated sets of 3-9 concerts; single tickets become available August 2026.
quote: Subscription packages for the 2026/27 Walt Disney Concert Hall season are available beginning March 17, 2026... starting at $34/month

claim: LA's iconic comedy clubs cluster in Hollywood: The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and Hollywood Improv present nightly stand-up, with intimate live music at The Troubadour and The Roxy in West Hollywood.
quote: The Comedy Store, Laugh Factory, and Hollywood Improv, presenting nightly performances... intimate performances can be found at The Troubadour and The Roxy in West Hollywood
